info.title: dvb engine API
info.description: The owner API over /run/dvb/engine.sock. Generated; do not edit.

200.description: Every event after `after` (or `Last-Event-ID`), then new ones as they happen

get.summary: The store captures a consistent cursor; goal order is read under a short guard.

parameters.name: role
parameters.description: Activity for a role, including its tasks and runs.

parameters.name: kinds
parameters.description: Comma-separated event kinds. Omitted means every kind.

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: Latest evidence per project/kind/task/goal, rather than all observations.

parameters.name: summary
parameters.description: Include project ordering and attention counts across the entire log.

200.description: Bounded recent events and an exclusive older-page cursor
Default branch check discovery; only discovered with empty checks confirms absence

post.summary: The desk generates fresh callback state; the engine retains the converted App/key.

200.description: Retry installation with a fresh link

get.summary:
Suggestions for Create App from what an earlier App stored: the installed or
pending App's organization, and the owner identity it recorded. The engine
does not run as the owner, so the owner's git config is the desk's to add.

200.description: Stored Create App values, each null when unknown
Repositories reachable by the installed App

post.summary:
Change the goal a stated goal with no started task waits for before
planning; `after: null` clears it.
Drop a goal: cancel its planned tasks and close its questions.

Ask a parked plan's question again ("Ask me again"): the same plan and
goal version, with no orchestrator run and no new plan.

get.summary:
`GET /logins`: which vendors' login files are present, and which vendors a
new project's default hires need.

200.description: Which vendors are logged in and which a new project needs

requestBody.description: Absent: start a login run. With the run and the code: finish it.

200.description: Active install-wide model switch, or null

put.summary: Sets the project's brief, recorded only as `project.brief_set` in the log.

200.description: The brief now in effect; empty text clears it

post.summary: Validate a complete candidate tree, then append all changes in one transaction.

put.summary: Replace the saved merge check choice; empty expected lists never mean no CI.

200.description: Project with the saved check choice

get.summary: Read the initial choice and later owner writes, scoped by the event project.

The project's open issues for attaching to a goal; untrusted ones are listed
with title and link only and are refused as goal issues.

How many open issues there are, how many are trusted and how they are
labelled, read from the forge now: the app offers "Work from the open
issues" when `trusted` is above zero.

post.summary: No new runs and no new effects; what is in flight carries on.

Ask the orchestrator to propose the next goal from the open trusted issues,
for a project with no goal stated or in progress. It asks the owner one
question, as after a goal is done; approving it states the goal from the
proposed issues.

202.description: The orchestrator is woken to propose; the counts it starts from

post.summary:
Refused while the project has running or open tasks, or a run still working.
Frees its run directories, mirror, toolchain cache and mirror receipts; makes
no GitHub call.

200.description: The removed project and the files that could not be freed; records `project.removed`

put.summary:
Only the same repository, read by its id through the App's installation, is
accepted. Goals, tasks and history stay; the mirror's receipts move with it.

200.description: The project under its repository's new name; records `project.repo_changed`

post.summary: The owner's last look at the project: records `project.seen`.

204.description: Recorded `project.seen`: the owner's last look at the project

200.description: The issue as it would be filed, and its new-issue URL

get.summary: The run's live lines (`run.output`) after `after`, oldest first.

200.description: The identity dvb publishes commits as

put.summary:
Saved in `state/publication.json` like the owner identity App setup
stores; the next commit dvb publishes uses it. Without `as_owner`, an
empty name or email is dvb's default. A refusal's detail names the field
and the rule it broke.

200.description: The identity dvb now publishes commits as

get.summary: What is running and what needs the owner, for one project or all.

200.description: What is running and what needs the owner
The head's diff against its base

post.summary: Resumes a stopped task from the state it stopped in.

Retries a failed task: a builder on its head after failed CI or used-up
review rounds, its merge with no run for an approved head that failed only
to merge, else a new run from its kept workspace or head. A task stopped
or in review with a PR gets a builder on its PR's head (a review in
progress is stopped first); any other state is refused with a code.

200.description: Retried: a new run, or back to its checks and merge

409.description: Refused, with a code: only a failed task, or one stopped or in review with a PR, is retried

post.summary:
Stops a task in any state; a stopped or ended task is refused with
`ALREADY_STOPPED` or `ALREADY_TERMINAL`. The reason is recorded on
`task.stopped`; with one, the orchestrator is not woken about the stop.

200.description: The verdict on the current head

get.summary:
The running version and the newest release, if it is newer (`?check=true`
reads GitHub now; otherwise the last check's answer). Reads GitHub
(`DVB_RELEASES_URL` overrides the public list; `DVB_GITHUB_TOKEN` is needed
only for a private fork's releases). A dev-mode engine has no release source
unless one is given. When the list cannot be read the answer is 502 with the reason.

post.summary:
Fetches and verifies the release, then drains and hands over in the
background (202). A refusal comes back at once as `UPDATE_REFUSED`.

200.description: Tokens, estimated cost and vendor windows

Answer.description: The owner's answer: one of the options, or a reply in words.

Brief.description:
A project's brief: private context for its runs, kept only in dvb's event
store. An empty text clears it.

BuilderOutcome.description: A builder's completion assertion, independent of review and CI.

oneOf.description: None places the role last on its current reporting line.
Exchange a direct report and its lead, including their other reports.

ChartMove.description: Atomic chart operations. Group members must share a reporting line.

CheckObservation.description: One check run or commit status on a head, by name.

run.description: Failed Actions check run id; workflow attempts bound automatic reruns.

ChecksStatus.description:
CI evidence on a head, per expected name and overall. Only
`success` on every expected name counts.

oneOf.description: These check names must report success on the head.

expected.description: These check names must report success on the head.

oneOf.description: The owner explicitly chose "no CI"; the verdict states the local gates ran.

CiMode.description: How a project's merges are gated on CI.

diff.description: Unified diff of the publication head against its base.

Effect.description: An external effect the engine performs, retried on its own schedule.

oneOf.description: The engine stopped the run at its kind's time limit (`caps::time_limit`).

Event.description:
One row of the `events` table. On the wire `kind` and `payload` sit at the top
level, as in the table.

EventId.description: The store's rowid of an event; also the SSE event id.

oneOf.description:
An update finished: the target binary is current. `snapshot` names the
backup taken before it.

payload.description:
An update finished: the target binary is current. `snapshot` names the
backup taken before it.

oneOf.description:
An update did not take: the database is back as it was and the old binary
carries on.

payload.description:
An update did not take: the database is back as it was and the old binary
carries on.

oneOf.description: Successful creation, with the immutable forge identity for setup recovery.

payload.description: Successful creation, with the immutable forge identity for setup recovery.

oneOf.description: The exact root commit, recorded before the empty-ref setup push.

payload.description: The exact root commit, recorded before the empty-ref setup push.

oneOf.description:
The owner opened the project: Home's "last looked" mark. The
project's events after its latest `project.seen` are new to the owner.

payload.description:
The owner opened the project: Home's "last looked" mark. The
project's events after its latest `project.seen` are new to the owner.

oneOf.description:
The owner set the project's brief: private context for the project's
runs, kept only in this log (never sent to the forge).

payload.description:
The owner set the project's brief: private context for the project's
runs, kept only in this log (never sent to the forge).

oneOf.description: What dvb found in the repository's open issues when the project was added.

payload.description: What dvb found in the repository's open issues when the project was added.

oneOf.description:
GitHub allows no ruleset on this repository (a private repository on
GitHub Free), so its default branch has none of dvb's; dvb goes on
without it. Recorded when it starts, not again while it lasts.

payload.description:
GitHub allows no ruleset on this repository (a private repository on
GitHub Free), so its default branch has none of dvb's; dvb goes on
without it. Recorded when it starts, not again while it lasts.

oneOf.description: A project that had no ruleset got dvb's when its checks were set.

payload.description: A project that had no ruleset got dvb's when its checks were set.

oneOf.description:
The owner pointed the project at its repository's new name, checked
to be the same repository; earlier events keep the name they had.

payload.description:
The owner pointed the project at its repository's new name, checked
to be the same repository; earlier events keep the name they had.

oneOf.description:
GitHub gave no token for the project's repository by its saved name
(HTTP 422). Recorded once, until a mirror write succeeds or the
project is repointed.

payload.description:
GitHub gave no token for the project's repository by its saved name
(HTTP 422). Recorded once, until a mirror write succeeds or the

oneOf.description:
The owner removed the project from this install: it leaves every
view and takes no goal. Its earlier events stay; GitHub is untouched.

payload.description:
The owner removed the project from this install: it leaves every
view and takes no goal. Its earlier events stay; GitHub is untouched.

Planning waits until this goal is Done or Dropped.

issues.description: Trusted issues the goal carries, read when it was stated; closed when it is Done.

oneOf.description: The owner dropped the goal: it is never planned, started or woken for again.

payload.description: The owner dropped the goal: it is never planned, started or woken for again.

oneOf.description: The owner changed the goal's `after`; null clears it.

payload.description: The owner changed the goal's `after`; null clears it.

oneOf.description:
The owner asked the orchestrator to propose the next goal from the
project's open issues. No goal exists until the owner approves one.

payload.description:
The owner asked the orchestrator to propose the next goal from the
project's open issues. No goal exists until the owner approves one.

oneOf.description: Mirror availability only; it does not change the goal or task state.

payload.description: Mirror availability only; it does not change the goal or task state.

oneOf.description:
The mirror's receipt for a goal's milestone or a task's card: the
digest of what GitHub confirmed, or none after a failed send, so
the next pass sends it again. A goal's carries its milestone number.

payload.description:
The mirror's receipt for a goal's milestone or a task's card: the
digest of what GitHub confirmed, or none after a failed send, so
the next pass sends it again. A goal's carries its milestone number.

main_ci.description: Project-wide main CI hold; absent in historical questions.

oneOf.description: The task this failure question concerns; absent in historical events.
The question no longer needs an owner answer.

payload.description: The question no longer needs an owner answer.

oneOf.description: The task's run (its `run.started` has the role, hire and model).

payload.description: The task's run (its `run.started` has the role, hire and model).

branch_repair.description: Bringing a conflicting branch up to date costs no review round.

retried.description:
A builder round a retry granted: it may build past the
review-round cap until it publishes. Older retries of a failed
task are read from their `task.state` instead.

oneOf.description:
The orchestrator's start of an approved task was refused for the cap on
concurrent runs: the engine starts it as asked (the same model,
effort and reason; none means the role's active hire) when a run ends.

payload.description:
The orchestrator's start of an approved task was refused for the cap on
concurrent runs: the engine starts it as asked (the same model,
effort and reason; none means the role's active hire) when a run ends.

routine.description: The start marked the task routine.

update.description: Resume this stop once after update handover or rollback.

oneOf.description:
Private builder context, appended atomically with an accepted owner retry.
None clears the previous retry's text. Historical retries have no event.
Texts not set by the engine also go to the task's reviewers.

payload.description:
Private builder context, appended atomically with an accepted owner retry.
None clears the previous retry's text. Historical retries have no event.
Texts not set by the engine also go to the task's reviewers.

oneOf.description: Not shown in the feed; refreshes the current run's task status.

payload.description: Not shown in the feed; refreshes the current run's task status.

oneOf.description: Not shown in the feed; the source of the `tasks` projection's state.

payload.description: Not shown in the feed; the source of the `tasks` projection's state.

boundary.description: The unit and user the run is confined to, as checked.

est_cost.description: Estimated cost in US dollars, from the release's price table.

oneOf.description:
A taskless run must stop even if the launcher acknowledgement is lost
and the engine hands over before its end is confirmed.

payload.description:
A taskless run must stop even if the launcher acknowledgement is lost
and the engine hands over before its end is confirmed.

oneOf.description:
Startup confirmed this run was still active; its eventual normal end
must remain a completion during replay.

payload.description:
Startup confirmed this run was still active; its eventual normal end
must remain a completion during replay.

detail.description:
For a crashed run: the worker's exit code and one-line cause,
when it left one. Absent otherwise and in older events.

stderr.description:
For a crashed run: the last lines its session's CLI wrote to
stderr, secret-scrubbed, at most 400 bytes. Absent otherwise
and in older events.

oneOf.description:
The run's unit is about to start: its time limit counts from here,
not from `run.started` (a queued run has no unit yet).

payload.description:
The run's unit is about to start: its time limit counts from here,
not from `run.started` (a queued run has no unit yet).

oneOf.description:
The run outlived its kind's time limit; the engine stops its unit and
it ends `time_limit`.

payload.description:
The run outlived its kind's time limit; the engine stops its unit and
it ends `time_limit`.

oneOf.description:
Before launch the engine moved this run under a timed switch, or to the
orchestrator's vendor at a usage limit. Its
`run.started` stays as recorded; `to_model`, `vendor` and `effort` are what
it runs on now.

payload.description:
Before launch the engine moved this run under a timed switch, or to the
orchestrator's vendor at a usage limit. Its
`run.started` stays as recorded; `to_model`, `vendor` and `effort` are what
it runs on now.

oneOf.description: The vendor at its limit; absent for a timed model switch.
Starts (or replaces) the one install-wide model switch.

payload.description: Starts (or replaces) the one install-wide model switch.

oneOf.description: Ends only the switch identified by its start event; stale timers are inert.

payload.description: Ends only the switch identified by its start event; stale timers are inert.

oneOf.description:
The engine brought the task's branch up to date with the base branch,
once the base moved while the task awaited checks or after a merge
refused it as behind: its own merge commit of `base` into
`from`, neutral author and committer. `same_change`: the PR's own patch
(`git patch-id --stable`) is unchanged, so the clean verdict on `from`
is carried over to `head` (a `verdict.recorded` copy follows); otherwise
review runs again. CI always runs again on `head`.

payload.description:
The engine brought the task's branch up to date with the base branch,
once the base moved while the task awaited checks or after a merge
refused it as behind: its own merge commit of `base` into
`from`, neutral author and committer. `same_change`: the PR's own patch
(`git patch-id --stable`) is unchanged, so the clean verdict on `from`
is carried over to `head` (a `verdict.recorded` copy follows); otherwise
review runs again. CI always runs again on `head`.

oneOf.description:
The whole verdict, attributed from the engine's record of the reviewer run
(`run.started` with `reviews: head`), never from its body.

payload.description:
The whole verdict, attributed from the engine's record of the reviewer run
(`run.started` with `reviews: head`), never from its body.

oneOf.description: Engine-selected stage, absent in historical verdicts.
The shared main-CI question this head waited for.

retry_runs.description: Check ids authorized for one recovery rerun after that hold.

oneOf.description:
A changed set of required checks observed Pending on this head.
The event timestamp starts newly Pending checks' durable timers.

payload.description:
A changed set of required checks observed Pending on this head.
The event timestamp starts newly Pending checks' durable timers.

oneOf.description:
A required check on the task's head has been Pending past
`caps::CHECK_PENDING_LIMIT`: told to the owner once per check and
head; the task keeps waiting.

payload.description:
A required check on the task's head has been Pending past
`caps::CHECK_PENDING_LIMIT`: told to the owner once per check and
head; the task keeps waiting.

EventKind.description:
One variant per line of `contracts/events.md`. On the wire: `kind` is the
dotted name and `payload` the fields.

Evidence.description: What an event rests on, where it exists.

Finding.description: One review finding. Its schema is generated into `prompts/verdict.schema.json`.

line.description: Required; `null` when the finding has no line, otherwise 1 or more.

open.description: True while the finding blocks the merge.

GithubAccountType.description:
The kind of GitHub account the App is created under; its login is the
`organization` field. Apps set up before personal accounts were supported are organizations.

GithubCheckDiscovery.description:
Only `discovered` with an empty checks list confirms absence on this head.
Pending or unreadable observations are still checks, never absence.

oneOf.description: The type of the `organization` account, null while no App is pending or installed.

GithubFailure.description: Safe, actionable setup/discovery failure. Never contains GitHub response bodies.

GithubManifestRequest.description: Starts the private App manifest flow. Identity remains local to the engine.

GithubPrefill.description:
`GET /github/prefill`: suggestions for Create App's fields, each null when
unknown. The engine gives what an earlier App stored; the desk's route of the
same name adds the owner's git `user.name` and `user.email`.

GoalAfter.description: The goal a stated goal waits for before planning; null clears it.

GoalIssue.description:
An issue a goal carries: its fenced, secret-scanned content as read when the
goal was stated.

plan_parked.description:
The owner answered its plan question with an option that does not
approve the plan ("Not yet"): the plan is on hold, nothing asks or
runs for it, until `POST /goals/{id}/resume` asks the question again.

oneOf.description: The predecessor still holding this goal's planning.

retired.description: Hires retired by this transaction, in their prior selection order.

HireCreated.description: Owner hiring receipt. Existing hire fields stay at the top level.

HireId.description: A hire: an agent (model and effort) in a role.

HireRecord.description: An agent hired into a role: a model and an effort.

routine.description:
The role's routine hire: it builds routine tasks and every fix round
on an open PR. A role has at most one active routine hire beside its
default hire; a new hire replaces only the active hire of its own kind.

HireView.description: `GET /hires`: a stored hire and the engine's default hire for its role.

InstallWarning.description: Something on the engine's machine only re-running install.sh fixes.

IssueCounts.description:
Counts of a repository's open issues under the trust rule, read from the
forge (`GET /projects/{id}/issues/counts`, and `project.issues_found` when
the project was added).

labels.description: Open issues per label, most used first, then by name.

trusted.description: Open issues dvb may propose and put into prompts.

IssueListing.description:
`GET /projects/{id}/issues`: an open issue of the project's repository. An
untrusted issue is shown with its title and link only, and never reaches a run's prompt.

trusted.description:
Any issue of a private repository; in a public or internal one, opened
by the owner, a member or a collaborator.

LapsesOn.description:
What a question lapses on: the version (the id of the event that last
set it) of the goal or value it asks about. A newer version refuses the answer
with `QUESTION_LAPSED`.

LoginCode.description:
The optional body of `POST /logins/{vendor}`: the second call, once the owner
has the URL. `code` is what the vendor's page showed (Claude: pasted back into
the login run); an empty `code` just waits for the login to finish (Codex: the
page took the device code). The reply's `prompt` then says how it ended.

LoginStarted.description: A login run inside the vendor's unit: its progress, URL and instructions.

LoginStatus.description: Login progress, independent of the human-readable prompt.

Logins.description: `GET /logins`: which vendors' login files are present.

needed.description:
The vendors a new project's default hires will use, so their sign-in is
needed; empty when no model is selected. Fake needs no sign-in.

MirrorPass.description: A GitHub mirror pass: when it started and whose job it runs now.

oneOf.description: Absent between two jobs of the pass.

ModelMode.description: How the engine selects models for new work.

NeedsYouTask.description: A failed or stopped task waiting on the owner.

oneOf.description:
Its open question that leaves it stopped; counted with the task, not
on its own.

reason.description:
Why it failed or stopped, as the task view's `reason` (or the
failure's) says; absent when nothing says why.

oneOf.description: An existing goal in this project; wait until it is Done or Dropped.

from_issue.description: Closed when the goal is Done; its text is not read.

issues.description:
Issues of the project's repository the goal carries; each must be trusted.
The goal's last PR closes them.

text.description: May be empty when `issues` names at least one issue.

routine.description: Hire the role's routine hire, replacing only its current routine hire.

create.description: Explicitly create a new private repository before setup.

default_branch.description: The repo's default branch when absent.

repo.description: A GitHub `owner/name`, or a local path for the Fake forge in dev mode.

OnlyModels.description: The install-wide timed model restriction. Its event id identifies replacements.

OutputItem.description: One live line of a run (bounded by `RUN_OUTPUT_MAX_BYTES`).

PlannedTask.description: One task in a proposed plan.

routine.description: Routine work for the role's routine hire (fixes, tests, docs, chores).

PoolModel.description:
One model the install may use. Model ids are full strings
(`claude-sonnet-5-5`, `gpt-6.1-sol`, `fake-1`).

PreflightCode.description: Preflight check codes; each has a fix hint in `prompts/preflight.md`.

goals.description: Goals in their original statement order, independent of generated ids.

ProjectRemoval.description:
A project removed from this install, and its files on this machine that
could not be freed, each as `<path>: <error>`.

ProjectRepo.description: The project's repository under its new name, after a rename or transfer.

oneOf.description: Open issues found when the project was added; absent when they could not be read.

Only in the response to adding the project: the repository's most
recent dvb commit names someone other than dvb's publishing identity.

PublicationChange.description:
`PUT /settings/publication`: who dvb's next published commits name as
author and committer.

as_owner.description:
Publish as the owner: the name and email may be theirs as recorded at
GitHub setup. Off keeps them out.

PublicationMismatch.description:
The publishing identity and the author of the repository's most recent
dvb commit, when they differ.

recent_is_owner.description: `recent` is the owner as recorded at GitHub setup.

PublishingIdentity.description:
`GET /settings/publication`: who dvb's published commits name as author
and committer.

as_owner.description:
The owner chose to publish as themself: the name and email may be
theirs as recorded at GitHub setup.

QuestionFormat.description: How a question is laid out; the owner's setting is the default.

QuestionId.description: A question put to the owner.

oneOf.description: One completion decision for this exact builder result.

completion.description: One completion decision for this exact builder result.

QuestionKind.description: Why the engine opened a question; omitted metadata identifies historical records.

QuestionOption.description: One option of a question. `id` is its 1-based position (`dvb answer <q> 1`).

approves_plan.description: Choosing it approves the goal's proposed plan (`goal.approved`).

effect.description: What choosing it does, in the owner's words.

no_effect.description:
Choosing it changes nothing (the team waits): the answer closes the
question without waking the orchestrator.

oneOf.description:
Choosing it is the owner's yes to retrying this task (failed, or
stopped or in review with a PR): the orchestrator may then `dvb run
task retry` it, once.

The goal it asks about: its task's goal, or the goal whose version it
lapses on. Absent for a question about a setting or the install.

Typed engine actions; completion choices 1=merge anyway, 2=retry check,
3=leave stopped. Bound to one result, never a general merge permission.

plan.description: The persisted tasks presented for plan approval.

oneOf.description: Attributed task, including compatibility with historical failure questions.

RateLimit.description: A GitHub budget wait, independent of failure attempts.

RecordedRefusal.description: Durable refusals retain retired wire codes; current API refusals use `Refusal`.

Redirect.description: "Change course": the goal's new text; the old plan is cancelled.

Refusal.description: A refused command: the code and a detail for people (never matched on).

oneOf.description: An update was refused before it began; the detail says why.
A run was served by a model other than the one asked for.

The issue, in a public repository, was not opened by the owner, a
member or a collaborator; only its link is given.

A project name is empty or has a character other than ASCII letters,
digits, `-` and `_`.
Only a goal whose plan is on hold (`plan_parked`) can be resumed.
A goal's order can change only while it is stated with no started task.
The goal order would wait on itself.

The new repository name reaches no repository through the App's
installation, or a different one from the project's.

A project with running or open tasks, or a run still working, is not
removed; `tasks` names them and the detail says how to stop each.

A project's remove or repoint waited too long for the GitHub mirror
pass and changed nothing; the detail says when the pass started.

RefusalCode.description:
The code, with the few fields some codes carry. Serialized with the code in
`code`, e.g. `{"code": "CAP_REACHED", "which": "concurrent_runs"}`.

Report.description: `POST /report`: what the owner wrote. Nothing is filed or recorded.

ReportPreview.description:
The issue exactly as it would be filed, and the GitHub new-issue URL that
opens it prefilled.

ResourceWait.description: A resource admission hold, or its release.

Restore.description:
`POST /roles/{id}/restore` and `/hires/{id}/restore`: bring back the value set
by `event`. `current` is the latest event the owner was looking at; if the
record changed since, the restore is refused with `VALUE_CHANGED`.

RetryTask.description: Optional missing information accompanying a retry; does not replace the task.

text.description: At most 16 KiB of UTF-8, like owner role instructions. Blank means no text.

ReviewKind.description: Which reviewer a task's head needs when no lead or assignment decides it.

RoleChanges.description: Fields to change on a role. Omission preserves the current value; null clears an assignment.

RoleFields.description: A role's complete editable value for creation and history; the engine makes the slug.

RoleId.description:
A role record. Unique in the install; the default roles' stable names are
in `RoleRecord::slug`.

RoleRecord.description: A role in a project's company.

lane.description: What the role decides (and writes SWOTs for).

oneOf.description: Review assignment, apart from reporting.

slug.description:
Stable name used by routing and prompts: the defaults' are `orchestrator`,
`architect`, `frontend`, `backend`, `code-reviewer`, `design-reviewer`,
`clerk`; a new role's is made from its name.

RunAssignment.description:
Who runs, on what: the start record every run has (`run.started`), written
before its unit starts. The engine chooses all of it; the runs projection, usage
attribution and reviewer evidence are rebuilt from it.

base.description:
The commit the run's workspace starts from, chosen by the engine. A
builder's publication commit is built on it, never on a parent
the run reports. Absent only in logs written before it existed.

oneOf.description:
The goal version selected for an orchestrator wake. New wakes record it
at admission; absent in task runs and historical logs, whose binding is
rebuilt with the legacy selection rule.
Engine-selected review stage; absent in historical runs and builders.

reviews.description:
For a reviewer run: the publication head it reviews, the only head its
verdict may name.

routine.description: A builder round of a routine task: the plan or this start marked it.

oneOf.description: Absent for an orchestrator wake that is not working on a task.

RunId.description: One run of an agent CLI in a unit.

RunKind.description:
What a run does: plan (no task), build a task (any building role,
the clerk's included), or review a head.

oneOf.description: Absent while the run is live.

reviews.description: For a reviewer run: the head it reviews.

SetOnly.description: `PUT /only`: exact selected model ids, in priority order, for 1–168 hours.

Settings.description:
Settings by key. `PUT /settings` takes only the keys to change.
`max_runs` is an install-wide whole number, minimum 1, default 3, with no policy upper limit.

half_ram_gb.description: Read-only warning threshold: half the PC's RAM in whole GiB.

ram_gb.description: Read-only total PC RAM, rounded down to whole GiB.

propertyNames.description:
Supported settings names. The string wire shape remains compatible with
existing clients and settings.changed events.

SettingsKey.description:
Supported settings names. The string wire shape remains compatible with
existing clients and settings.changed events.

StartUpdate.description:
`POST /update`: install the newest release, or `to` (a version the database
schema of this one can read).

oneOf.description: The GitHub mirror pass running now; absent between passes.

rulesets_missing.description:
The names of the projects whose default branch has no dvb ruleset,
because GitHub Free allows none on a private repository.

tasks.description: The failed or stopped tasks `needs_you` counts, one each.

warnings.description: Absent when the install has nothing to fix.

StopTask.description: Why the owner stops a task. A stop with a reason wakes no orchestrator to ask why.

TaskId.description: A task in a goal's plan.

oneOf.description: Resumable; `was` is where it stopped.
Until observed again after a restart or a lost unit query.
Terminal; from "change course", or a failure whose goal was dropped.
Ended, unless the owner retries it (`Retry`).

after.description: Enforced PR-merge dependencies, including ones already satisfied.

problem_superseded.description: A later merged task of this goal resolved this failed or stopped work.

reason.description:
Derived display reason, including failures cancelled by a dropped goal.
Older task views omit this field.

round_model.description:
The model the task's latest builder round runs or ran on (after any
reroute); absent before its first round.

routine.description:
The plan or the orchestrator's start marked the task routine: its
builder rounds run on the role's routine hire when it has one.

waiting_for.description: Unmerged prerequisites for a never-started task. State remains Planned.

Timestamp.description: Milliseconds since the Unix epoch, UTC.

pending.description: Update stops still waiting to resume (including startup reconciliation).

oneOf.description: The latest handover's interrupted task runs and their recovery.
Present while an update is under way.

UpdateStatus.description: An update that has started: waiting for runs to finish, then switching.

runs_active.description: Runs still going; drain waits up to 30 seconds, then stops them.

est_cost.description: US dollars, estimated from the release's price table.

VendorWindow.description: A vendor's usage window, read at no cost.

VerdictId.description: A reviewer's verdict on one head.

Version_CiMode.description: One past value of a role, hire or setting: the event that set it.

oneOf.description: These check names must report success on the head.

expected.description: These check names must report success on the head.

oneOf.description: The owner explicitly chose "no CI"; the verdict states the local gates ran.

value.description: How a project's merges are gated on CI.

Version_HireFields.description: One past value of a role, hire or setting: the event that set it.

Version_RoleFields.description: One past value of a role, hire or setting: the event that set it.

value.description: A role's complete editable value for creation and history; the engine makes the slug.

Version_Value.description: One past value of a role, hire or setting: the event that set it.
